top_signals.title: China's CXMT shares fall nearly 8% as investors look past chipmaker's profit turnaround
top_signals.summary: CXMT shares fell nearly 8% on Monday after the company released its earnings forecast for the first nine months of 2026.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Lindt CEO Exits as Swiss Chocolate Industry Struggles
top_signals.summary: Lindt is changing its chief executive officer as it tries to engineer a turnaround and deal with record-high cocoa costs and weak consumer demand that have weighed on the Swiss confectionary industry.
